author: Yang Quanheng (via Qclaw Daemon)
optimization_notes: Redesigned to use SINGLE TASK with internal self-healing logic. Avoids concurrent task conflicts (Qclaw maxConcurrentRuns=1). Uses cron expression for precise timing.

tasks.name: immortal_evolution
tasks.description: Single evolution loop with internal self-healing

internal_phases.name: janitor
internal_phases.description: Clean Docker, delete mocks, clear cache

internal_phases.name: generate
internal_phases.description: Read flow.har, generate mock code, start Docker

internal_phases.name: self_check
internal_phases.description: If chaos failed: analyze logs, apply patches

schedule_design.rationale: Qclaw has maxConcurrentRuns=1, so multiple tasks would queue and potentially delay each other. Using a single task with internal phases ensures sequential execution without conflicts.

timing.self_healing: Internal - triggered if chaos phase fails
timing.no_separate_watchdog: Not needed - self-check built into main task

critical_test_case.description: The gauntlet validates this error handling is preserved
